faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the GGSMCH Project Technical Support III (Clinical Pharmacist) post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 26th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates should have a Graduate degree in pharmacy with three years of experience, or a Post Graduate degree in Pharmacy, or a BSc Nursing with three years of clinical/ICU/Nursing Teaching experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Technical Support III (Clinical Pharmacist) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this post is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support III (Clinical Pharmacist) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 32,340 per month, which includes the basic pay and HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and submit it along with self-attested documents to the Principal Office, Guru Gobind Singh Medical College, before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee. General category candidates need to pay Rs. 1770, and SC category candidates need to pay Rs. 885.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Walk-in Interview and a Written Test.

faq.question: Q8. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted on 27th August 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or temporary job?
faq.answer: This is a temporary position.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location?
faq.answer: The job location is Guru Gobind Singh Medical College and Hospital, Faridkot, Punjab.
